items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Malcolm X. [INTERVIEWEE] A man who happened when he should have happened.

ctx.x: That is a tough one. I know two or three, but five is tough. Ravel’s Daphnis and Chloe would certainly be one. Stravinsky’s Rite of Spring or Firebird Suite would be one. Miles Ahead would certainly be one. I’d have to think about the rest. Now it's getting tough. It's getting tough now because there are so many – I have so many now that I need, you need to give me about fifteen, twenty more choices. I don’t have them. I only have two or three more choices. So it's tough. It's tough now because I can think of a…
Well, three speaks volumes. Three speaks volumes. Let me just run
some names. Just one-line responses. Just names. These are non-music people. Malcolm X.
